text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Listen to my beautiful voice! I've fully recovered from that curse brought upon me by that super spicy death sauce!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Dober, my rival at the upcoming Shuka Sho, is in the audience watching me today. I'll show her just how well I can run!
